info.title: Bloom API
info.description: HTTP contract of the Bloom personal agent. Authenticated routes rely on the Better Auth session cookie; chat replies stream as Server-Sent Events.

get.description: Reports that the server is up and returns its current time.
Returns the user the session cookie belongs to.

post.description: Creates a `side` or `quest` thread; the `main` thread cannot be created here (see `GET /api/threads/main`). When `contextScope` is omitted, side threads get `minimal` and quests get `full`.
post.summary: Create a side thread or quest

get.description: The single ongoing conversation. Created on first call, so this is idempotent and never 404s.
Messages in chronological order. With `limit`, only the most recent `limit` messages are returned, still oldest first.

post.description: Appends the user message to the thread, runs the agent, and streams `ChatStreamEvent`s as Server-Sent Events until `message_end` (or `error`).
post.summary: Send a message and stream the reply

get.description: Tasks in creation order, optionally filtered by one or more statuses.

post.description: Creates a task. Omitted fields take their defaults (`status: inbox`, nullable fields `null`).

patch.description: Partial update: only the keys present are changed. `completedAt` is managed by the server from `status`.

delete.description: Removes the task. Responds 204 with no body.

tags.name: Threads
tags.description: Conversation threads: the main thread, side threads, and quests.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Chat turns. Replies stream as text/event-stream.

tags.name: Tasks
